product_overview: CampusHub lets students report lost & found items, create marketplace listings, and chat with peers about items — all within a single authenticated mobile app.
core_goals: Allow students to report and discover lost or found items with photos and location context
Enable students to create and browse campus marketplace listings to buy and sell items
Provide real-time peer-to-peer messaging so students can negotiate or ask questions about reports and listings
Offer a single dashboard for quick discovery and navigation between marketplace, skills hub, lost & found, and messages

features.name: Lost & Found Reporting
features.description: Create and publish a lost or found item report with photos, item details, and location so other students can discover and respond.
user_flows: Navigate to /post-item -> Select Lost or Found type -> Tap Add Photo to select from camera or gallery -> Enter Item Name -> Enter Location -> Enter Description -> Tap Post to submit -> See new report appear on /(tabs)/lost-found

Navigate to /(tabs)/lost-found -> Browse listed reports -> Select a report to view details -> Tap Message button on the item detail page to initiate contact -> Type and send message -> See conversation appear in /messages

features.name: Marketplace Listing
features.description: Create a marketplace listing to sell items on campus with images, price, category, and detailed description so buyers can find and contact sellers.
user_flows: Navigate to /post-market -> Tap Add Photo to select from camera or gallery -> Enter Title -> Enter Price -> Enter Category -> Enter Item Details -> Tap Create Listing to submit -> See new listing appear on /(tabs)/market

Navigate to /(tabs)/market -> Browse marketplace listings -> Select a listing to view details -> Tap Message button on the item detail page to ask about the item -> Type and send message -> See conversation appear in /messages

features.name: Peer Messaging
features.description: Send and receive real-time messages with other students to discuss listings and lost & found reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /(tabs)/market -> Select an item to view details -> Tap Message button on the item detail page -> Type message in chat input -> Send message -> See conversation appear in /messages
Navigate to /messages -> Open a conversation from the inbox -> Type and send messages in the chat view -> See sent messages appear in the conversation thread
